evidence: Modifies src/wallet/rpc/signmessage.cpp, src/wallet/wallet.cpp, and src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp to generate BIP322 simple proofs.
rationale: Enables descriptor wallets to sign BIP322 simple proofs for native P2WPKH, P2WSH, and P2TR addresses. This resolves a persistent user limitation preventing owners of modern addresses from proving ownership off-chain without broadcasting on-chain transactions.
